name: Texas Envirothon
org: Environmental Institute of Houston, University of Houston-Clear Lake
city: Statewide, TX (state event in Nacogdoches in 2026)
what_you_do: Teams of five high school students study soils, water life, wildlife, forestry and a current issue. They take field tests and give an oral presentation at the state contest.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12, or the home school match. You join a team of five from the same school or group. The team has an adult advisor.
pay_detail: A non-refundable team registration fee is required each year. The amount is not stated on the program pages.
deadline_text: 2026 state event: March 28 to 30, 2026 in Nacogdoches. Page says registration opens in 2026 with the deadline to be announced.
how_to_apply: Contact the Texas Envirothon office at 281-283-3045 or reistle@uhcl.edu. Then send in the sign-up packet and the fee. You must show proof of health insurance.
notes: Teams need an adult advisor plus chaperones of each gender. The school or group pays for travel, meals and lodging. Teams with fewer than five can play but may lose points on the oral part.
